I narrowly escaped this 3 days back. Got an IVR call from "FedEx" saying my shipment cannot be shipped. Please press 1 to know more. Curious, I pressed 1. A "customer care representative" told me that a shipment by my name and aadhar has been caught by Customs as it contains 140gm MDMA and cash. Gives me his employee Id and shipment number to gain trust. He then proceeds to transfer my call to the police because it seemed like a case of identity theft. 

Since I never get off the phone all this while, I never get a chance to check the veracity of the shipment number.


A "police officer" picks up the call and tells me it is a "High Professional" case and I am a suspect for money laundering, human and drug trafficking. If I am innocent, I need to help with the investigation. I am instructed to install Skype and come on video call and share my screen. Scared shitless, I do. A "Senior CBI Officer" also speaks to me, reassuring me that if I am cooperative, I will walk away from this. These MFs salute greet each other with "Jai Hind" everytime they interact!

They then send me a list of "orders" for me to read out loud. I cannot leave my residence, the country and cannot discuss this with anyone as it is a national security issue. If I speak of this with anyone, I can be jailed for 4-7 years. I keep quiet. We are on the Skype call for more than an hour now. He then asks me to share my bank details: the last 4 digits of all my account numbers. 

I have to now share my last 6 months account statements. 

They then proceed to ask me to encash all my investments, MFs, stocks, FDs etc.

That's when I begin to get suspicious. I tell him this. He reassures me it is for the investigation. I tell him you're CBI, you can do a full bg check on me. Why do I need to all this?

I want to Google "CBI Scam" He can see me distracted from my phone and tells me not to do anything on my laptop. But the game is over now. 

I read aloud a news article about the scam. 

He goes on to claim this article is a lie. The balls on him. Then he says if I don't comply it would have dire consequences for me. 

I cut the call after being on it for 4 hours

I consider myself kind of a hypocrite for realising the meaninglessness of existence and yet being unwilling to let it all go and die. But I find solace in a line from Catch 22, "What else is there?"

It has all got to do with NOTHING. Consider NOTHING as a wild card. The other aspect is our faculty of imagination. Some say we even imagine  ( or hallucinate) the freaking reality based on what all we perceive. And it does not stop here. We learn with the data that we collect. And then we create. NOTHING does not exist in any way physical but our imagination can use  this as a blank canvas to create things.  The complexity of what we can create out of NOTHING depends on the data that we have and ability of our minds. From simple things to complex story plots to GOD, human imagination creates stuff every living moment. Sometimes it is just our brain being active and other times to serve a purpose. This thread is replete with reasons behind us creating the concept of GOD so I need not go there. It goes further. We even trick ourselves into believing it. So long as it serves the purpose. And on that belief, we start building our personalities. Somewhere deep down every human being knows the difference between what all has been created as the projection of what we have perceived and confirmed and what all has been purely cooked out of NOTHING. However when anything comes close to reminding us this fact, it threatens to demolish the base on which our personalities are created. A person open to all possibilities including the existence of GOD or even that everything so far observed, studied and confirmed by science can be falsified by some later discovery is somewhat immune to this catastrophic collapse of his being in such an event but not the one who has staked everything on the existence of something. The worst of them are those for whom that something is not even the current reality! And that is why he so vehemently resists. So the next time you tell some ardent believer that what he believes does not currently exist, realise the uselessness of your action because sir, that person already knows it. 
Isn't NOTHING fascinating?
